full_ids.rule: Scene name, then each ancestor from the root as .[siblingIndex]Name; lookups test the whole string (Regex is an unanchored ECMAScript search).

transforms.order: scale, then localPosition (else position), then localRotation (else rotation); track-driven updates apply scale, rotation, then position each frame a track changes.

light_id_registration.rule: New lights (duplicates, OpaqueLight/TransparentLight/BillieWater geometry, ILightWithId components) take the requested lightID, moving up past taken keys, else max key + 1.

geometry_primitives_unity.Cube: 1 x 1 x 1 box centred on the origin
geometry_primitives_unity.Quad: 1 x 1 in XY, single-sided, facing -Z (towards the player)

Triangle.note: single-sided; its front faces +Z (away from the player at identity rotation); keep the same vertices and order in Godot (front then faces Godot -Z, still away from the player).

geometry_primitives_unity.godot: BoxMesh size 1; SphereMesh radius 0.5 height 1; CapsuleMesh radius 0.5 height 2; CylinderMesh radii 0.5 height 2; PlaneMesh 10x10 (faces +Y); QuadMesh 1x1 (faces +Z in Godot = -Z in Unity).

materials.rule: shader -> material: Standard/BTSPillar with shaderKeywords [] -> Glowing with colour alpha 0 (BS 1.40.8+); OpaqueLight/TransparentLight/BillieWater make the object a light (TubeBloomPrePassLight + ILightWithId registered with a new lightID); Obstacle is listed but has no material and fails. Material colour defaults to (0,0,0,0).

cases.result: OpaqueNeonLight light object; colour from lighting events of its ILightWithId type
the Interscope environment's 'Concrete2' material copy, colour (1,1,1,1)
